blind.description: A small wooden bucket or tub bound with dark metal bands and studs, filled to the brim with rough chunks of iron/copper ore. An arched dark metal bail or hoisting handle spans across the top with a central lifting ring. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylised with clean geometry, standing flat on its own circular base without any extraneous ground or mounting plinth.
blind.from_above: A circular wooden rim enclosing irregular chunks of rocky ore, spanned across the middle by a straight dark metal handle with an eyelet loop at its center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.8 feet tall (about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.3 feet wide.
